correctness.rationale: Direct differentiation gives ω₁(h)=Ψ(1/h)q(1/(ch))/[ch(1+1/(ch))²]; q′=(x+1)(ax-b)/x² proves its sole global minimum Θ and all sign and equality cases. On the negative interval Ψ increases, forcing a signed inverse kernel and a positive-SOE error at least half its exact increase; the one-exponential high-rate family achieves the infimum. Taylor expansion at the nondegenerate minimum proves square-root onset. A standalone checker supplements, but does not replace, these infinite-domain arguments.
